summary: Completed testing of P0 bug fixes for custom items (Piatti Liberi) and P1 PDF multi-page support. All backend API tests passed (11/11). Frontend UI verified working correctly.

issues: Deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props - Use 'boxShadow' instead
React Native warning: Unexpected text node in <View> components

critical_code_review_comments: Console deprecation warnings should be addressed for better code quality but not blocking functionality
seed_data_creation: Created test orders with custom items (Piatti Liberi) for testing by-index endpoints
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fixes verified: 1) Custom items (Piatti Liberi with dishId=null) can now be deleted using DELETE /api/orders/{id}/items/by-index/{index} endpoint. 2) Custom items can have their status changed using PUT /api/orders/{id}/items/by-index/{index}/status endpoint. 3) Frontend uses removeItemByIndex and updateItemStatusByIndex functions from api.ts. 4) Menu PDF generation includes @media print and @page CSS rules for multi-page support.

details.custom_item_deletion: Successfully deletes custom items (Piatti Liberi) without dishId
details.total_recalculation: Order total is correctly recalculated after deletion
details.portions_restoration: Portions are restored for regular menu items (not custom items)

details.status_to_pending: Successfully updates item status back to 'pending'
details.order_status_auto_update: Order status is automatically updated based on item statuses (all ready=pronto, any problem=sospeso, all pending=in_attesa)

details.removeItemByIndex: Function in api.ts correctly calls DELETE /api/orders/{id}/items/by-index/{index}
details.updateItemStatusByIndex: Function in api.ts correctly calls PUT /api/orders/{id}/items/by-index/{index}/status

details.media_print_rules: @media print CSS rules present with height:auto, overflow:visible, page-break-inside settings
details.page_rules: @page CSS rule present with A4 size and 15mm/10mm margins
details.condividi_button: Share/Condividi button visible and functional on Menu page

rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: Custom items (Piatti Liberi) with dishId=null could not be deleted or have their status changed because the existing endpoints used dishId as the identifier. Fix: Created new by-index endpoints that use the array index instead of dishId, allowing operations on any item regardless of whether it has a dishId.
